summary.plain: The United States' national laboratory for accelerator-based science, run by Stanford University in Menlo Park, California. It built a two-mile-long linear accelerator and later ran two colliders, SLC and PEP-II. Work at the laboratory has won Nobel Prizes in Physics.
summary.technical: DOE Office of Science national laboratory (Menlo Park, California), operated by Stanford University; historically home to the 3.2 km SLAC linac (up to 50 GeV electrons), the SLC electron-positron collider (1989-1998) and the PEP-II B-factory (1999-2008).
